sentences.text: This animal belongs to the family Rhomaleosauridae.
A fossil trader found a uniquely complete skeleton in a pile of discarded quarry rocks.
It took more than nine months to remove 2.5 tonnes of rock to reveal the bones.
Adam S. Smith and Peggy Vincent named the genus Meyerasaurus in 2010.
The name honors the German paleontologist Hermann von Meyer, who first suggested the name Thaumatosaurus.
The original holotype specimen was destroyed in a firestorm in Stuttgart on September 12, 1944.
It lived in the early Toarcian stage of the Early Jurassic, approximately 183 to 180 million years ago.
Other estimates place its time range between 184.2 and 182.9 million years ago.
In 2007, Adam Stuart Smith suggested creating a separate genus because he viewed Thaumatosaurus as a nomen dubium.
